input.quote: Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others.
input.rationale: No non-compete, exclusivity, field-of-use or territory covenant binds Customer anywhere in the Agreement. Searches for "compet*", "shall not develop", "exclusiv*", "minimum" and "Customer shall not" surface no restriction on the businesses we may operate or the products we may buy or build. To the contrary, § 14.16 (Freedom of Action) affirmatively preserves each party's right to enter into similar agreements with others, and § 14.17 limits licences to those expressly granted (a reciprocal IP provision, not a business restraint). The only "shall not" binding us is § 14.11 (No Resale) — "Customer shall not resell the Services, in whole or in part" — which is a scope-of-use limit on IBM's own Services rather than a restraint on our own products or lines of business, and § 12.1's routine no-reverse-engineering limit on the Base Components licence; neither is a non-compete within this rule. § 14.19 (Geographic Scope) limits IBM's delivery obligations, not our activities. This meets the preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer), so no redline is proposed.
